subject: Special term approval needed to retain Kiwi Health — discount + SLA add-on
messages:
From: Samantha Liu <samantha@kiwihealth.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Jul 2027 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Upcoming renewal — need a retention offer (pricing + SLA)

Hi Jonas,

We are coming up on the 12/31 renewal for our Redwood contract. Usage has crept up across several teams and overall spend is now above what procurement expected. We love Redwood's performance, but given price pressure internally and a competing vendor quoting a 30% discount + 99.95% SLA for a portion of our workload, procurement is asking us to get a materially better commercial.

Can you put together a retention offer that includes: a limited-term discount (15-25% band), an SLA addendum for 99.95% with a small service credit for missed availability, and a two-month credit to offset overage in Q3? We need something concrete in writing by end of week to avoid a formal RFP.

Appreciate your help — happy to hop on a quick call if needed.

Best,
Samantha Liu
Head of Platform Engineering
Kiwi Health

Attachments: procurement_requirements_kiwi.pdf (ref)
From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Liu <samantha@kiwihealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Jul 2027 10:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Upcoming renewal — need a retention offer (pricing + SLA)

Hi Samantha,

Thanks for the clear ask and the heads-up on the competitive pressure. I can get you a concrete offer by Friday EOD. Initial plan:
- 20% discount on list rates for the committed annual spend bucket (12 months)
- 2 months of service credit applied as a one-time invoice credit for Q3 overage
- SLA addendum offering 99.95% for critical tier workloads (with 1x service credit per incident up to a cap)

I'll coordinate internally to get approvals for the concession and will share the redlineable SLA addendum. Monica, looping you in for CS sequencing and to confirm impact on commitment thresholds.

Jonas
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference

Laura — forwarding the ask from Kiwi Health. Summary and ask below:

Summary:
- Account: Kiwi Health (large payer / clinical data processing)
- Current ARR: ~$1.2M; expected growth next year given usage trends
- Retention risk: Procurement is pushing for competing vendor offering ~30% off + 99.95% SLA for some workloads

Requested concessions to win:
1) 20% list discount on committed annualized spend (12-month term)
2) 2 months of invoice credit (one-time) to offset Q3 overage
3) SLA addendum: 99.95% guarantee for critical workloads with modest credit formula (draft attached)

Why approve: high strategic value (clinical partner, reference potential), churn would be ~60% revenue loss across product usage, long lead sales motion to replace and migrate. If we keep them, they will expand to two additional lines of business in 2028 (sales forecast).

Requested approval: Exec sign-off to permit 20% discount + SLA addendum and credit. If you prefer, approve a 15% fallback and we can escalate for the remaining delta.

Attachments: Kiwi_Health_MA_Pricing_Options.pdf, SLA_Addendum_draft.docx

Thanks — Monica
Senior Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference

Monica / Jonas,

After reviewing the account economics and risk, I approve the following concession package to be used for retention (final language to be executed by Legal):

- Pricing: 18% discount off current list for a 12-month committed renewal. We should position 20% as our ask but set 18% as the authorized sign-off level.
- Credit: 2 months of invoice credit (one-time) applied to Q3 billing as proposed.
- SLA: Approve execution of the SLA addendum with the 99.95% target. Keep the credit formula conservative: 1% service credit for each 30 minutes of downtime beyond threshold, capped at 3% per month.

Conditions:
1) Commit to a 12-month term with minimum committed spend equal to at least 90% of current ARR.
2) Legal to include standard audit and termination clauses; no multi-year term resets without further exec approval.
3) Deal desk to log the concession in the CRM and flag for future quota/comp adjustments.

Monica, please prepare a one-page offer summary and send to Jonas to share with Kiwi. Jonas, include DocuSign link and mark the offer valid for 7 days.

Laura Bennett
VP, Customer Success
Redwood Inference
